limits: The minor grapes together: at most 10%

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

climate: Merlot, Cabernet Sauvignon, Cabernet Franc and Malbec sit in their sweet spot, so the wines can show the style they are known for.

blurb.text: A Bordeaux Right Bank appellation for red wine, just north of Pomerol across the Barbanne stream. It is made from Merlot, Cabernet Franc, Cabernet Sauvignon and Cot, and its main villages are Lalande-de-Pomerol and Néac.
